675	        function formatNumber(val, decimals = 2) {{
676	            if (val === null || val === undefined) return 'N/A';
677	            return Number(val).toLocaleString('en-US', {{ minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals }});
678	        }}
679	
680	        function formatPnL(val) {{
681	            if (val === null || val === undefined) return 'N/A';
682	            const sign = val >= 0 ? '+' : '';
683	            return sign + formatNumber(val);
684	        }}
685	
686	        function formatTime(ts) {{
687	            if (!ts) return 'N/A';
688	            const date = new Date(ts);
689	            return date.toLocaleTimeString();
690	        }}

203	    *,

228	    # End = start + duration; expires_at must cover session window + small auth skew.

51	def assert_real_tty_v1(*, stdin_isatty: bool | None = None) -> list[str]:
52	    tty = bool(sys.stdin.isatty()) if stdin_isatty is None else bool(stdin_isatty)
53	    if not tty:

55	    return []

51	def assert_real_tty_v1(*, stdin_isatty: bool | None = None) -> list[str]:
52	    tty = bool(sys.stdin.isatty()) if stdin_isatty is None else bool(stdin_isatty)
53	    if not tty:
54	        return ["REAL_TTY_REQUIRED", "HIDDEN_PTY_STDIN_NOT_TTY"]
55	    return []

861	def validate_ratification_preconditions(repo_root: Path) -> tuple[ManifestVerification, ...]:
862	    bundles = (
863	        SOURCE_EVIDENCE_DIR,
864	        EHLERS_TERMINAL_SCOPE_DEFINITION_DIR,
865	        EL_KAROUI_TERMINAL_INCONCLUSIVE_DIR,
866	    )
867	    verifications = tuple(verify_manifest_sha256(path) for path in bundles)
868	    if any(item.manifest_verify_rc != 0 for item in verifications):
869	        raise ValueError("source_manifest_verification_failed")
870	    admissibility = evaluate_armstrong_cycle_v1_admissibility_contract_v1(repo_root=repo_root)
871	    if admissibility.admissibility_result.value != "PASS":
872	        raise ValueError(f"admissibility_blocked:{admissibility.blocking_reasons}")
873	    return verifications
874	
875

892	        repo_root,

479	def sync_reratified_digest_fields(
480	    binding: Mapping[str, Any],
481	    *,
482	    fresh_binding: Mapping[str, Any],
483	) -> dict[str, Any]:
484	    updated = dict(binding)
485	    updated["binding_digest"] = fresh_binding["binding_digest"]
486	    binding_body = dict(updated["binding"])
487	    binding_body["digest_bindings"] = fresh_binding["binding"]["digest_bindings"]
488	    updated["binding"] = binding_body
489	    return updated

493	    binding: Mapping[str, Any],

483	) -> dict[str, Any]:
484	    updated = dict(binding)

297	def write_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
298	    payload = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
299	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
300	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
301	    path.write_text(
302	        json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
303	        encoding="utf-8",
304	    )
305	    return payload
306	
307	
308	def load_and_validate_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
309	    expected = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
310	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
311	    _require(path.is_file(), "ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_MISSING")
312	    loaded = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
313	    for key in (
314	        "config_digest",
315	        "strategy_params_digest",
316	        "frozen_measurement_contract_digest",
317	        "dataset_binding",
318	        "development_run_count",
319	        "runner_start_count",
320	        "evaluation_authorized",
321	        "development_evaluation_authorized",
322	        "holdout_forbidden",
323	        "time_segment_definition_id",
324	        "status",
325	    ):
326	        _require(loaded.get(key) == expected.get(key), f"ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_DRIFT:{key}")
327	    return loaded

295	def write_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
296	    payload = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
297	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
298	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
299	    path.write_text(
300	        json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
301	        encoding="utf-8",
302	    )
303	    return payload

306	def load_and_validate_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
307	    expected = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
308	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
309	    _require(path.is_file(), "ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_MISSING")
310	    loaded = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

321	        "time_segment_definition_id",
322	        "status",
323	    ):
324	        _require(loaded.get(key) == expected.get(key), f"ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_DRIFT:{key}")
325	    return loaded

707	def compute_ratification_implementation_digest_v0() -> str:
708	    return hashlib.sha256(
709	        serialize_canonical_json(
710	            {
711	                "module": RATIFICATION_ID,
712	                "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
713	                "confirm_go": CONFIRM_GO,
714	                "entry_point": ENTRY_POINT,
715	                "parking_owner": PARKING_OWNER,
716	                "overlap_validation_owner": OVERLAP_VALIDATION_OWNER,
717	                "archive_correction_owner": ARCHIVE_CORRECTION_OWNER,
718	                "coverage_freshness_owner": COVERAGE_FRESHNESS_OWNER,
719	                "reopen_requires": REOPEN_REQUIRES,
720	                "scope_status_reopened": SCOPE_STATUS_REOPENED,
721	            }

297	def write_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
298	    payload = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
299	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
300	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
301	    path.write_text(
302	        json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
303	        encoding="utf-8",
304	    )
305	    return payload
306	
307	
308	def load_and_validate_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
309	    expected = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
310	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
311	    _require(path.is_file(), "ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_MISSING")
312	    loaded = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
313	    for key in (
314	        "config_digest",
315	        "strategy_params_digest",
316	        "frozen_measurement_contract_digest",
317	        "dataset_binding",
318	        "development_run_count",
319	        "runner_start_count",
320	        "evaluation_authorized",
321	        "development_evaluation_authorized",
322	        "holdout_forbidden",
323	        "time_segment_definition_id",
324	        "status",
325	    ):
326	        _require(loaded.get(key) == expected.get(key), f"ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_DRIFT:{key}")
327	    return loaded

295	def write_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
296	    payload = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
297	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
298	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
299	    path.write_text(
300	        json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
301	        encoding="utf-8",
302	    )
303	    return payload
304	
305	
306	def load_and_validate_entry_point_binding(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
307	    expected = materialize_entry_point_binding_payload(repo_root)
308	    path = repo_root / ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_REL_PATH
309	    _require(path.is_file(), "ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_MISSING")
310	    loaded = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
311	    for key in (
312	        "config_digest",
313	        "strategy_params_digest",
314	        "frozen_measurement_contract_digest",
315	        "dataset_binding",
316	        "development_run_count",
317	        "runner_start_count",
318	        "evaluation_authorized",
319	        "development_evaluation_authorized",
320	        "holdout_forbidden",
321	        "time_segment_definition_id",
322	        "status",
323	    ):
324	        _require(loaded.get(key) == expected.get(key), f"ENTRY_POINT_BINDING_DRIFT:{key}")
325	    return loaded

801	    return verifications

733	def detect_idempotent_binding_status_v0(
734	    *,
735	    repo_root: Path,
736	    new_completion: Mapping[str, Any],
737	) -> IdempotentBindingStatus:
738	    path = repo_root / CONFIG_REL_PATH
739	    if not path.is_file():
740	        return IdempotentBindingStatus.NEW_BINDING
741	    existing = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
742	    if existing.get("completion_digest") == new_completion.get("completion_digest"):
743	        return IdempotentBindingStatus.NO_OP_SUCCESS
744	    if existing.get("dataset_content_digest") == DATASET_CONTENT_DIGEST:
745	        return IdempotentBindingStatus.CONFLICT_BLOCKED
746	    return IdempotentBindingStatus.NEW_BINDING

372	def _candidate_has_required_fields(candidate: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
373	    missing: list[str] = []
374	    for field in REQUIRED_BINDING_FIELDS:
375	        if field not in candidate:
376	            missing.append(field)
377	        elif candidate[field] in (None, "", {}):
378	            missing.append(f"{field}:empty")
379	    return tuple(missing)

382	def validate_post_pr4895_versioned_fleet_binding_ratification_v0(
383	    completion: Mapping[str, Any],
384	    *,
385	    v3_completion: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
386	) -> BindingValidationResultV0:
387	    fail_reasons: list[str] = []
388	
389	    if completion.get("status") != "FLEET_BINDINGS_RATIFIED_NOT_EVALUATED":
390	        fail_reasons.append("status_not_fleet_bindings_ratified_not_evaluated")
391	    if completion.get("strategy_version") != STRATEGY_VERSION:
392	        fail_reasons.append("wrong_strategy_version")
393	    if not completion.get("fleet_bindings_ratified"):
394	        fail_reasons.append("fleet_bindings_not_ratified")
395	    if completion.get("all_required_bindings_complete") is not True:
396	        fail_reasons.append("all_required_bindings_not_complete")
397	    if completion.get("economic_evaluation_authorized"):
398	        fail_reasons.append("economic_evaluation_must_not_be_authorized")
399	    if completion.get("economic_evaluation_executed"):
400	        fail_reasons.append("economic_evaluation_must_not_be_executed")
401	    if completion.get("same_binding_retry_allowed"):
402	        fail_reasons.append("same_binding_retry_must_be_false")
403	    if completion.get("failed_bindings_retry_allowed"):
404	        fail_reasons.append("failed_bindings_retry_must_be_false")
405	
406	    candidates = completion.get("candidates")
407	    if not isinstance(candidates, list) or len(candidates) != len(RESEARCH_CANDIDATES):
408	        fail_reasons.append("candidate_count_mismatch")
409	
410	    if isinstance(candidates, list):
411	        for candidate in candidates:
412	            if not isinstance(candidate, Mapping):
413	                fail_reasons.append("candidate_not_mapping")
414	                continue
415	            missing = _candidate_has_required_fields(candidate)
416	            if missing:
417	                fail_reasons.append(
418	                    f"missing_bindings:{candidate.get('strategy_id')}:{','.join(missing)}"
419	                )
420	            if candidate.get("strategy_version") != STRATEGY_VERSION:
421	                fail_reasons.append(f"wrong_candidate_version:{candidate.get('strategy_id')}")
422	            if not candidate.get("substantially_differs_from_v3"):
